question.text: Map the chain from a Aerospace / Defense market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester.

exchange.sent: Map the chain from a Aerospace / Defense market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester.

answer.answer:
已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
The supported chain is Aerospace / Defense private-5G resilience in contested RF / EW environments → measure handover interruption, RTT, packet loss / jitter, throughput, and application QoS → use a signaling tester that can emulate 5G NR cells, execute mobility / handover scenarios, and run IP application measurements; the cited source uses R&S CMX500 as the 5G network emulator for this setup [61][62][64][31].
### Chain mapping
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tactical edge connectivity, smart jamming / improved EW tactics, contested spectrum, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, secure command-and-control networks, and tactical private 5G adoption are listed as mission / market drivers [65]. | Handover interruption interval is a key metric, with modem B never exceeding 75 ms and modem A reaching 150 ms in some cases [64]. | The tester needs 5G NR signaling / network emulation and mobility / handover execution, because the tested mitigation maps resilience to 5G handover signaling and uses CMX500 as the network emulator [62][31]. | Market driver [65]; metric [64]; tester role [31][62]. |
| Mission-critical / tactical 5G requires service continuity against smart jamming in contested RF / EW environments [61]. | RTT is measured, with more than 90% of RTT below 20 ms and worst 0.1 percentile near 80 ms for modem B and 200 ms for modem A [64]. | The tester needs IP application measurement capability such as Ping and throughput, because CMX500 application testing includes Ping, iPerf, throughput, and IP logging [5]. | Requirement [61]; metric [64]; capability [5]. |
| Public safety, critical infrastructure, and military purposes need reliable, fast, secure communications, and real-time video stream needs at least 2 Mbit/s [3]. | The white-paper setup used uplink / downlink target data rate of 2 Mbit/s, ping at 100 Hz, and iPerf updates every second [2]. | The tester needs application-layer test functions for IP throughput and video / audio, because UAV signaling test solution lists IP throughput, Video, and Audio as application-layer tests [40]. | Requirement [3]; measurable setup [2]; capability [40]. |
| The resilience problem is mapped to handover frequency hopping across cells / carrier frequencies so that the jammer must listen and readjust to every change [62]. | The setup uses three 5G SA cells on n41, n78, and n79 with center frequencies 2.50713 GHz, 3.30087 GHz, and 4.62399 GHz [34]. | The tester needs multi-cell 5G SA signaling with NR FR1 RF resources, because the CMX500 test setup had two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports, and up to eight cells [31]. | Requirement / method [62]; measurable carriers [34]; capability [31]. |
| The constraint is to harden the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT by putting the strategy in the network / infrastructure / orchestration around it [3]. | The test measures QoS impact under handover-based frequency hopping rather than modifying the DUT [35]. | The tester needs to act as a network-side emulator around the DUT, and CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing [6]. | Constraint [3]; measurement scope [35]; capability [6]. |
| UAV products can use Radio, Wi‑Fi, LTE, 5G, SATCOM, RTK, and proprietary radio technologies [39]. | Supported signaling-test RF measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [40]. | The tester needs LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test coverage, because the UAV signaling test solution says CMX500 provides LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test over 400 MHz to 8 GHz [40]. | Requirement context [39]; measurable parameters [40]; capability [40]. |
| CMX500 Callbox is positioned for RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D validation [9]. | Example non-signaling / RF validation use cases include sensitivity testing, desense testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, and non-signaling verification [72]. | The tester needs both signaling and non-signaling validation workflows, because CMX500 Callbox explicitly lists Non-Sig Testing and R&D Testing among its testing phases [71]. | Use-case scope [9]; measurable RF/non-signaling areas [72]; capability category [71]. |
### Minimum capability set supported by the passages
| Tester capability | Why it is required in the chain | Supported product / option facts | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5G NR signaling and network emulation | Handover frequency hopping requires 5G handover signaling across multiple cells / carriers [62]. | R&S CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, and it is a one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [6]. | [62][6] |
| Multi-cell FR1 setup | The resilience test used three 5G SA cells on n41, n78, and n79 [34]. | The tested CMX500 configuration had two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports, and could create up to eight cells [31]. | [34][31] |
| Mobility / handover testing | The mitigation is implemented as handover frequency hopping between carrier frequencies / cells [29]. | CMX500 Callbox lists Mobility Testing as an application / mobility use case [74]. | [29][74] |
| IP application measurements | The measurable outcomes include RTT, throughput, WebRTC statistics, jitter buffer delay, and lost or discarded packets [64]. | CMX500 KA100 includes iPerf, Ping, throughput, IP logging, FTP, HTTP, DNS, and related IP services [5]. | [64][5] |
| Throughput / video QoS testing | The mission need includes real-time video stream of at least 2 Mbit/s [3]. | The UAV signaling test solution lists Application layer test items including IP throughput, Video, and Audio [40]. | [3][40] |
| RF / non-signaling verification | UAV communication validation can require RF parameters such as Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [40]. | CMX500 Callbox lists Non-Sig Testing as a testing phase and non-signaling verification as an example use case [71][72]. | [40][71][72] |
| WLAN / cellular desense and multi-technology validation | UAV products may combine Wi‑Fi, LTE, 5G, proprietary radio, SATCOM, RTK, and other communications [39]. | CMX500 Callbox includes WLAN / cellular desense validation in its use-case positioning, and CMX500 supports WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements [9][6]. | [39][9][6] |
### Limitations
The passages do not provide a formal Aerospace / Defense procurement requirement that directly mandates a specific CMX500 option stack [32][69].
The smart-jamming source does not provide physical jammer hardware, jammer waveform, jammer power, tracking algorithm, detection delay, or attack success rate [32].
The handover-frequency-hopping result mainly demonstrates feasibility, latency, and QoS impact, not a physical smart-jammer confrontation test [35].
The UAV signaling test solution does not provide test cases, standard versions, channel bandwidth, MIMO layers, OTA / conducted setup, pass / fail limits, or measurement uncertainty [40].
The CMX500 Callbox source lists non-signaling verification and other use cases but does not define pass / fail standards for the testing phases [71].

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 setup
白皮書中的 August 2025 測試 setup：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator。
- CMX500 configured device 有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- control PC command CMX500；measurement PC command UE。
- M.2 modem 透過 USB adapter board 存取 [[AT command]] port，並以 RF cables 直接連到 CMX500 RF ports。
- phones 使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 測試三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41 / 2.50713 GHz、n78 / 3.30087 GHz、n79 / 4.62399 GHz。
- UE received power 固定 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping 100 Hz；iPerf update 每秒一次；uplink / downlink target data rate 2 Mbit/s。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 問題定義
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17），簡報的 problem statement 是：

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；
- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；
- can the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT be hardened against [[Smart Jamming]] by using legacy FH capabilities。

來源特別強調 constraint：不修改 [[DUT]]；策略應放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration around it。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）補充：public safety agencies、critical infrastructure industries 與 military purposes 依賴 reliable、fast、secure communications；TETRA 等傳統系統 maximum data bit rate below 30 kbit/s，無法滿足 real-time video stream 至少 2 Mbit/s 與 extended reality 至少 30 Mbit/s 的需求。

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 › Signaling options（依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]）
以下 order number 後綴 `.xx` 均照 Features and Functions 原文抄錄；完整後綴不可推導。

B、M、X options 彼此相依；使用 M option 需要對應 B option；使用 X option 需要對應 B 與 M options，部分 X options 沒有 M option。Basic RedCap installations（R&S CMX-KS617/618B，無 M/X）不需要 R&S CMX-KS600B。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Callbox › unresolved
- 來源未標示簡報版本、作者、正式發佈日期與對應 CSW software release。
- 多個 use cases 未列出完整 option stack、BOM、DUT 條件或測試報告。
- Roadmap 字樣如 coming soon、coming in 2025 and later、planned for CSW 9.00 / 9.10 需以 release note 或正式 product documentation 補證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

NTN signaling customer discovery
[[NTN signaling customer discovery]] 是用問卷方式蒐集 [[Non-Terrestrial Network]] signaling 測試需求的方法，重點在把 service offering、network configuration、technology release、satellite architecture、UE、QoS、mobility 與 deployment workflow 問清楚，而不是直接宣稱產品能力。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 2. Test layer
來源要求客戶指出要測試哪一層：

- RF
- Protocol
- Application Testing

這表示 discovery 階段需先分清楚測試目標，而不是只用「NTN testing」作為單一需求描述。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 4. Satellite architecture
來源詢問：

- 是否將 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 中測試。
- gateway 使用哪些 bands。
- satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。

這些問題把 NTN 測試需求拆成 orbit、payload 與 gateway integration，而不是只停留在 waveform / protocol 名稱。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

2025RS Drone Solution › 與既有知識的關係
- [[UAV Technologies 外部資料清單]] 已保存 [[6. UAV Technologies]] 中 UAV regulation、standards、PDF 與 link hub 線索；本來源比 [[6. UAV Technologies]] 提供更完整的 drone EMC / EME test proposal 脈絡，但仍屬 Market 類簡報，缺 formal date / version。
- [[UAV signaling test solution]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[Wi-Fi]] 的 signaling test 與 De-sense validation；本來源則聚焦 EMC / EME / immunity / emissions / system-level RF environment，兩者互補但不可互相替代。
- [[UAV 通訊]] 記錄 C2、telemetry、payload data、SATCOM、4G/5G、Wi‑Fi、mesh 與 MAVLink / RTPS 等通訊議題；本來源補充通訊設備、GPS、mobile radio、broadcast emissions、data communications 與 power supply 可能形成 electromagnetic environment 的測試背景。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]] 討論 detection / neutralization；本來源只在 customised solution 中列 [[CUAS System Performance Verification]]，沒有提供 counter-UAS system 的技術分類、產品或效能數字。
- [[UAV 系統方塊圖]] 整理 UAV 子系統；本來源補充 drone components 如 battery、BMS、ESC、FCM、CM、antennas 與 sensors，但未提供 specific architecture 或 BOM。

2025RS Drone Solution › Drone / UAV / UAS 概念
- [[UAV]] — 來源定義為 platform vehicle。
- [[UAS]] — 來源定義為 entire system that supports drone operation，包含 UAV、controller、datalink、sensors 等。
- [[Drone EMC 測試]] — 來源核心議題，涵蓋 emissions、immunity、conducted layout、radiated layout、mounting mode、idle / active mode 與 EUT / AUT 環境。
- [[商用無人機 EMC standards]] — 來源整理 commercial drones 的 regulatory compliance、emission / immunity standards、Class A / Class B 與 application-dependent immunity level。
- [[軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing]] — 來源整理 [[MIL-STD-461]]、[[MIL-STD-464]]、[[RTCA DO-160]] 與系統層 EME effects testing。
- [[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] — 來源摘要 [[RTCA DO-160]] Section 15、16、17、18、19、20、21、22、25，並將 Section 20 對應 RF susceptibility、Section 21 對應 RF emissions、Section 22 對應 lightning induced transients、Section 25 對應 ESD。

2025RS Drone Solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是由 `2025RS Drone Solution.pdf` 轉出的 lossy markdown，標題為 `DRONE TEST SOLUTION PROPOSAL`；來源檔名含 `2025RS`，但正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、版本或簡報完整封面。
- 來源以 [[EMC]] / [[EME]] 為主軸，說明 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在 residential、outdoor AUT、MIL battle environment 與 multi-domain operations 下會遭遇不同電磁干擾與測試需求。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 21 — Emission of RF Energy
來源說此測試確保 equipment does not emit excessive RF noise，以 protect aircraft sensors and receivers。來源分為：

- Conducted Emissions（low freq）。
- Radiated Emissions（high freq）。

標題中同列 [[RE102]] / CE，但未提供 limit table 或 exact mapping。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

SDR-assisted UAV security › unresolved
- 各 jamming / spoofing research 的法規授權、測試場地許可與 safety controls 未在本次摘要中完整展開。
- 來源沒有把 SDR-assisted security solutions 對應到商用產品 maturity level。
- [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF x40]]、[[Ettus USRP X310]] 等 device 在不同研究中的配置、firmware、clocking、antenna 與 calibration 條件需逐篇回查。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security
[[SDR-assisted UAV security]] 是使用 [[Software-Defined Radio]] 在 UAV 系統中執行 PHY-layer monitoring、jamming detection、GPS spoofing / jamming assessment、intrusion detection、penetration testing 與 counter-UAV research 的安全技術方向；它同時包含防禦能力與攻擊面風險。

Smart Jamming › unresolved
- 來源未定義 smart jammer 的完整技術分類、訊號特徵或 detection criteria。
- 來源未提供 jammer profile、jammer power、距離、頻段、掃頻 / 跳頻策略、dwell time 或 attack timeline。
- 來源未說明 smart-jamming test 是否使用實體 jammer、emulation、channel emulator 或 network-side impairment injection。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實驗並未提供 jammer reacquisition time 或 jamming success probability，因此不能量化 anti-jam security gain。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

Smart Jamming › 與一般 jamming 的區分限制
目前來源可以支持以下敘述：

- smart jamming 與 [[SDR]] accessibility 相關；來源把 cheaper / more powerful consumer RF equipment 視為 threat enabler。
- smart jammer 被描述為會追蹤 used frequency，而非只做固定頻率或寬頻干擾。
- smart jammer 在 specific moments 發射 noise，因此其 detection / tracking 較困難。

但來源仍沒有提供正式 taxonomy，不能區分其是否屬於 broadband noise jammer、spot jammer、swept jammer、protocol-aware jammer、reactive jammer 或 AI-assisted jammer。

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] white paper《5G hardening against smart jammer attacks》，文件標示 **PD 3610.1591.52 | Version 01.00 | August 2025 (ch)**，作者為 [[Miguel Villanueva Fernandez]] 與 [[Kristian Hausgaard Soerensen]]。raw frontmatter 顯示原始 PDF 於 2026-09-17 轉檔；本文內容日期以文件頁尾的 August 2025 為準。

白皮書主張：mission-critical、critical infrastructure 與 military 5G use cases 需要比商用網路更高的可靠性；但較便宜且可取得的 [[SDR]] equipment 可能被改造成 [[Smart Jamming]] 裝置，追蹤目前使用的通訊頻率並在特定時刻發射 noise 以干擾連線。來源提出以 [[Handover frequency hopping]] 作為 5G overlay countermeasure：利用所有 3GPP-compliant commercial 5G devices 都支援的 legacy [[5G Handover]] procedure，在不同 carrier frequency / cell 之間切換，使 jammer 必須持續偵聽並重新調整攻擊頻率。

來源明確把這個方法連到論文〈Enhancing 5G Resilience to Smart-Jammer Attacks: Incorporating Frequency Hopping to 5G〉，並說該論文提交給 Spring 2025 IEEE VTC conference，由 [[Aalborg University]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz Technology Center Denmark]] 合作完成。

主要測試設備與條件：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator；來源說 at the time of writing 可達 Release 18 features。
- 測試 CMX500 配置有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，提供四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 使用 control PC 控制 CMX500、measurement PC 控制 [[UE]]；M.2 modem 可直接以 RF cables 連到 CMX500，phone 類 DUT 則使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 使用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79；center frequencies 分別為 2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- 基本 HO repetition interval 為 5 s，除非另有指定；UE received power 固定為 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping frequency 100 Hz，即每 10 ms 一個 ICMP message；iPerf data rate 每秒更新一次；target uplink / downlink data rate 均為 2 Mbit/s，因來源稱這是 good quality video streams 的 minimum requirement。

主要量測結果：

- 來源沒有提供 modem A / modem B 的品牌、型號、chipset、firmware、antenna configuration 或 commercial name。
- 來源沒有提供實際 smart jammer hardware、jammer waveform、jammer power、距離、偵測延遲、追蹤演算法或攻擊成功率；多數測試是在 frequency hopping / handover feasibility 與 QoS impact，而非實體 jammer 對抗實驗。
- 來源提到 3GPP TS 38.300，但未標示 release / version。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 23.501]] V15.4.0（2018-12）作為 5QI QoS table，但白皮書本身是 August 2025；是否需用較新 3GPP release 做 mission-critical QoS 對照仍未裁決。
- 來源說 CMX500 at the time of writing can reach up to Release 18 features，但未提供具體 CMX500 software version、option list、hardware order numbers 或 full configuration。
- 來源未量化 security improvement，例如 jammer reacquisition time、probability of detection、probability of interruption 或 hop pattern entropy。
- Future work 包含 MOS、more random operating frequency configuration、dual connectivity / multi-connectivity 與 DAPS handovers，但本來源未實作。

Handover frequency hopping › 測試配置摘要
依 [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator。
- 測試 CMX500 有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 測試用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79。
- Cell center frequencies：2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- Default HO command interval：5 s。
- UE received power：-70.2 dBm。
- DL/UL pattern：7:2。
- MCS：downlink 10、uplink 4。
- Antenna / stream：SISO。
- ping frequency：100 Hz，即 10 ms 一個 ICMP message。
- iPerf update：每秒一次。
- target data rate：uplink / downlink 均為 2 Mbit/s。

Handover frequency hopping › 使用限制
- 本方法不代表 5G 已內建完整 anti-jam [[FHSS]] waveform；來源明確說 5G 的 key missing component 是 frequency hopping，而本方法是利用 handover feature 實作 overlay hopping。
- 來源沒有實體 jammer 測試細節；結果主要證明 handover-based hopping 的 feasibility、latency 與 QoS impact。
- 來源沒有 modem A / B 型號，因此不可推論特定商用 UE 的可靠性。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 在此是 test setup 中的 network emulator；本 Market source 不是產品規格書，頁尾也說 data without tolerance limits is not binding。
- 引用 QoS 結果時必須保留 test conditions：n41 / n78 / n79、SISO、-70.2 dBm、MCS 10 / 4、2 Mbit/s target、one-hour Teams call。

Handover frequency hopping › Different UE comparison
來源比較 modem A 與 modem B：

- modem B 的 [[HO interruption interval]] never employs more than 75 ms。
- modem A 在部分 cases 可到 150 ms，且較大 delay 總是發生在 largest frequency hop，也就是 n79 到 n41。
- 來源推測 modem B 的 RF sweep time 較短，但未提供 modem 型號或 RF implementation details。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；最差 0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms，modem A 接近 200 ms。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › Release 17：NTN baseline
[[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 明確稱 [[3GPP Release 17]] 是 NTN 的 technology baseline。

Release 17 正式將 NTN 導入 5G system specifications：

- [[IoT-NTN]]：以 [[NB-IoT]] / eMTC 為基礎的 NTN enhancement。
- [[NR-NTN]]：5G NR 對 satellite access 的 enhancement。
- FR1 S-band / L-band 中的 n255、n256 初始 bands，採 [[FDD]]。
- UE 需要 [[GNSS]] positioning 能力，以便計算 timing advance 與 Doppler precompensation。
- [[SIB19]] 導入 NTN system information，提供 satellite ephemeris、timing、reference location、validity timer 等資訊。
- PHY / MAC / RRC / NAS 各層均有 NTN adaptations，包括 time delay、Doppler shift compensation、path loss、timing advance、random access、HARQ、timer operation 與 mobility。
- MAC / HARQ 可擴充到 32 HARQ processes，並允許 disable HARQ feedback。
- RRC 層導入 NTN conditional handover。

[[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是 mission-critical / tactical 5G 測試問題：在 contested RF / [[EW]] 環境中，如何讓 deployed private [[5G]] connections 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具服務連續性。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。

### Short answer
The supported chain is Aerospace / Defense private-5G resilience in contested RF / EW environments → measure handover interruption, RTT, packet loss / jitter, throughput, and application QoS → use a signaling tester that can emulate 5G NR cells, execute mobility / handover scenarios, and run IP application measurements; the cited source uses R&S CMX500 as the 5G network emulator for this setup [61][62][64][31].
### Chain mapping
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tactical edge connectivity, smart jamming / improved EW tactics, contested spectrum, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, secure command-and-control networks, and tactical private 5G adoption are listed as mission / market drivers [65]. | Handover interruption interval is a key metric, with modem B never exceeding 75 ms and modem A reaching 150 ms in some cases [64]. | The tester needs 5G NR signaling / network emulation and mobility / handover execution, because the tested mitigation maps resilience to 5G handover signaling and uses CMX500 as the network emulator [62][31]. | Market driver [65]; metric [64]; tester role [31][62]. |
| Mission-critical / tactical 5G requires service continuity against smart jamming in contested RF / EW environments [61]. | RTT is measured, with more than 90% of RTT below 20 ms and worst 0.1 percentile near 80 ms for modem B and 200 ms for modem A [64]. | The tester needs IP application measurement capability such as Ping and throughput, because CMX500 application testing includes Ping, iPerf, throughput, and IP logging [5]. | Requirement [61]; metric [64]; capability [5]. |
| Public safety, critical infrastructure, and military purposes need reliable, fast, secure communications, and real-time video stream needs at least 2 Mbit/s [3]. | The white-paper setup used uplink / downlink target data rate of 2 Mbit/s, ping at 100 Hz, and iPerf updates every second [2]. | The tester needs application-layer test functions for IP throughput and video / audio, because UAV signaling test solution lists IP throughput, Video, and Audio as application-layer tests [40]. | Requirement [3]; measurable setup [2]; capability [40]. |
| The resilience problem is mapped to handover frequency hopping across cells / carrier frequencies so that the jammer must listen and readjust to every change [62]. | The setup uses three 5G SA cells on n41, n78, and n79 with center frequencies 2.50713 GHz, 3.30087 GHz, and 4.62399 GHz [34]. | The tester needs multi-cell 5G SA signaling with NR FR1 RF resources, because the CMX500 test setup had two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports, and up to eight cells [31]. | Requirement / method [62]; measurable carriers [34]; capability [31]. |
| The constraint is to harden the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT by putting the strategy in the network / infrastructure / orchestration around it [3]. | The test measures QoS impact under handover-based frequency hopping rather than modifying the DUT [35]. | The tester needs to act as a network-side emulator around the DUT, and CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing [6]. | Constraint [3]; measurement scope [35]; capability [6]. |
| UAV products can use Radio, Wi‑Fi, LTE, 5G, SATCOM, RTK, and proprietary radio technologies [39]. | Supported signaling-test RF measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [40]. | The tester needs LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test coverage, because the UAV signaling test solution says CMX500 provides LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test over 400 MHz to 8 GHz [40]. | Requirement context [39]; measurable parameters [40]; capability [40]. |
| CMX500 Callbox is positioned for RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D validation [9]. | Example non-signaling / RF validation use cases include sensitivity testing, desense testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, and non-signaling verification [72]. | The tester needs both signaling and non-signaling validation workflows, because CMX500 Callbox explicitly lists Non-Sig Testing and R&D Testing among its testing phases [71]. | Use-case scope [9]; measurable RF/non-signaling areas [72]; capability category [71]. |
### Minimum capability set supported by the passages
| Tester capability | Why it is required in the chain | Supported product / option facts | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5G NR signaling and network emulation | Handover frequency hopping requires 5G handover signaling across multiple cells / carriers [62]. | R&S CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, and it is a one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [6]. | [62][6] |
| Multi-cell FR1 setup | The resilience test used three 5G SA cells on n41, n78, and n79 [34]. | The tested CMX500 configuration had two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports, and could create up to eight cells [31]. | [34][31] |
| Mobility / handover testing | The mitigation is implemented as handover frequency hopping between carrier frequencies / cells [29]. | CMX500 Callbox lists Mobility Testing as an application / mobility use case [74]. | [29][74] |
| IP application measurements | The measurable outcomes include RTT, throughput, WebRTC statistics, jitter buffer delay, and lost or discarded packets [64]. | CMX500 KA100 includes iPerf, Ping, throughput, IP logging, FTP, HTTP, DNS, and related IP services [5]. | [64][5] |

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] white paper《5G hardening against smart jammer attacks》，文件標示 **PD 3610.1591.52 | Version 01.00 | August 2025 (ch)**，作者為 [[Miguel Villanueva Fernandez]] 與 [[Kristian Hausgaard Soerensen]]。raw frontmatter 顯示原始 PDF 於 2026-09-17 轉檔；本文內容日期以文件頁尾的 August 2025 為準。

白皮書主張：mission-critical、critical infrastructure 與 military 5G use cases 需要比商用網路更高的可靠性；但較便宜且可取得的 [[SDR]] equipment 可能被改造成 [[Smart Jamming]] 裝置，追蹤目前使用的通訊頻率並在特定時刻發射 noise 以干擾連線。來源提出以 [[Handover frequency hopping]] 作為 5G overlay countermeasure：利用所有 3GPP-compliant commercial 5G devices 都支援的 legacy [[5G Handover]] procedure，在不同 carrier frequency / cell 之間切換，使 jammer 必須持續偵聽並重新調整攻擊頻率。

來源明確把這個方法連到論文〈Enhancing 5G Resilience to Smart-Jammer Attacks: Incorporating Frequency Hopping to 5G〉，並說該論文提交給 Spring 2025 IEEE VTC conference，由 [[Aalborg University]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz Technology Center Denmark]] 合作完成。

主要測試設備與條件：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator；來源說 at the time of writing 可達 Release 18 features。
- 測試 CMX500 配置有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，提供四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 使用 control PC 控制 CMX500、measurement PC 控制 [[UE]]；M.2 modem 可直接以 RF cables 連到 CMX500，phone 類 DUT 則使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 使用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79；center frequencies 分別為 2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- 基本 HO repetition interval 為 5 s，除非另有指定；UE received power 固定為 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping frequency 100 Hz，即每 10 ms 一個 ICMP message；iPerf data rate 每秒更新一次；target uplink / downlink data rate 均為 2 Mbit/s，因來源稱這是 good quality video streams 的 minimum requirement。

主要量測結果：

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源沒有提供 modem A / modem B 的品牌、型號、chipset、firmware、antenna configuration 或 commercial name。
- 來源沒有提供實際 smart jammer hardware、jammer waveform、jammer power、距離、偵測延遲、追蹤演算法或攻擊成功率；多數測試是在 frequency hopping / handover feasibility 與 QoS impact，而非實體 jammer 對抗實驗。
- 來源提到 3GPP TS 38.300，但未標示 release / version。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 23.501]] V15.4.0（2018-12）作為 5QI QoS table，但白皮書本身是 August 2025；是否需用較新 3GPP release 做 mission-critical QoS 對照仍未裁決。
- 來源說 CMX500 at the time of writing can reach up to Release 18 features，但未提供具體 CMX500 software version、option list、hardware order numbers 或 full configuration。
- 來源未量化 security improvement，例如 jammer reacquisition time、probability of detection、probability of interruption 或 hop pattern entropy。
- Future work 包含 MOS、more random operating frequency configuration、dual connectivity / multi-connectivity 與 DAPS handovers，但本來源未實作。

Handover frequency hopping › 測試配置摘要
依 [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator。
- 測試 CMX500 有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 測試用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79。
- Cell center frequencies：2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- Default HO command interval：5 s。
- UE received power：-70.2 dBm。
- DL/UL pattern：7:2。
- MCS：downlink 10、uplink 4。
- Antenna / stream：SISO。
- ping frequency：100 Hz，即 10 ms 一個 ICMP message。
- iPerf update：每秒一次。
- target data rate：uplink / downlink 均為 2 Mbit/s。

Handover frequency hopping › 使用限制
- 本方法不代表 5G 已內建完整 anti-jam [[FHSS]] waveform；來源明確說 5G 的 key missing component 是 frequency hopping，而本方法是利用 handover feature 實作 overlay hopping。
- 來源沒有實體 jammer 測試細節；結果主要證明 handover-based hopping 的 feasibility、latency 與 QoS impact。
- 來源沒有 modem A / B 型號，因此不可推論特定商用 UE 的可靠性。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 在此是 test setup 中的 network emulator；本 Market source 不是產品規格書，頁尾也說 data without tolerance limits is not binding。
- 引用 QoS 結果時必須保留 test conditions：n41 / n78 / n79、SISO、-70.2 dBm、MCS 10 / 4、2 Mbit/s target、one-hour Teams call。

- [[UAV 通訊]] — 本來源補充 UAV 產品使用 Radio、Wi‑Fi、LTE、5G、SATCOM、RTK 與 proprietary radio 的例子。

- [[UAV signaling test solution]] — 本次建立的概念頁，整理本來源對 [[R&S CMX500]] 在 UAV signaling test / De-sense validation 的配置與使用限制。
- [[UAV 多技術 De-sense 驗證]] — 來源中的多技術整合驗證線索；目前只有概念性配置原則，未提供 test case、limits 或量測結果。
- [[Radio communication]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[SATCOM]]、[[RTK]]、[[MIMO]]、[[EVM]]、[[PER]]、[[BLER]]。

UAV signaling test solution › CMX500 可涵蓋的 signaling test 範圍
依 [[Signaling test solution]]，[[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 400 MHz 至 8 GHz，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test。來源列出的測試類別包含：

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

使用限制：來源未說明 test case、standard version、release、channel bandwidth、MIMO layers、OTA / conducted setup、automation interface、pass / fail limit 或 measurement uncertainty。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming
[[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是 mission-critical / tactical 5G 測試問題：在 contested RF / [[EW]] 環境中，如何讓 deployed private [[5G]] connections 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具服務連續性。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。

cited_passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。

CMX500 Callbox

NTN signaling customer discovery › 2. Test layer

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

passages.text:
DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 21 — Emission of RF Energy
來源說此測試確保 equipment does not emit excessive RF noise，以 protect aircraft sensors and receivers。來源分為：

- Conducted Emissions（low freq）。
- Radiated Emissions（high freq）。

標題中同列 [[RE102]] / CE，但未提供 limit table 或 exact mapping。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

SDR-assisted UAV security › unresolved
- 各 jamming / spoofing research 的法規授權、測試場地許可與 safety controls 未在本次摘要中完整展開。
- 來源沒有把 SDR-assisted security solutions 對應到商用產品 maturity level。
- [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF x40]]、[[Ettus USRP X310]] 等 device 在不同研究中的配置、firmware、clocking、antenna 與 calibration 條件需逐篇回查。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security
[[SDR-assisted UAV security]] 是使用 [[Software-Defined Radio]] 在 UAV 系統中執行 PHY-layer monitoring、jamming detection、GPS spoofing / jamming assessment、intrusion detection、penetration testing 與 counter-UAV research 的安全技術方向；它同時包含防禦能力與攻擊面風險。

Smart Jamming › unresolved
- 來源未定義 smart jammer 的完整技術分類、訊號特徵或 detection criteria。
- 來源未提供 jammer profile、jammer power、距離、頻段、掃頻 / 跳頻策略、dwell time 或 attack timeline。
- 來源未說明 smart-jamming test 是否使用實體 jammer、emulation、channel emulator 或 network-side impairment injection。
- [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 的實驗並未提供 jammer reacquisition time 或 jamming success probability，因此不能量化 anti-jam security gain。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

Smart Jamming › 與一般 jamming 的區分限制
目前來源可以支持以下敘述：

- smart jamming 與 [[SDR]] accessibility 相關；來源把 cheaper / more powerful consumer RF equipment 視為 threat enabler。
- smart jammer 被描述為會追蹤 used frequency，而非只做固定頻率或寬頻干擾。
- smart jammer 在 specific moments 發射 noise，因此其 detection / tracking 較困難。

但來源仍沒有提供正式 taxonomy，不能區分其是否屬於 broadband noise jammer、spot jammer、swept jammer、protocol-aware jammer、reactive jammer 或 AI-assisted jammer。

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] white paper《5G hardening against smart jammer attacks》，文件標示 **PD 3610.1591.52 | Version 01.00 | August 2025 (ch)**，作者為 [[Miguel Villanueva Fernandez]] 與 [[Kristian Hausgaard Soerensen]]。raw frontmatter 顯示原始 PDF 於 2026-09-17 轉檔；本文內容日期以文件頁尾的 August 2025 為準。

白皮書主張：mission-critical、critical infrastructure 與 military 5G use cases 需要比商用網路更高的可靠性；但較便宜且可取得的 [[SDR]] equipment 可能被改造成 [[Smart Jamming]] 裝置，追蹤目前使用的通訊頻率並在特定時刻發射 noise 以干擾連線。來源提出以 [[Handover frequency hopping]] 作為 5G overlay countermeasure：利用所有 3GPP-compliant commercial 5G devices 都支援的 legacy [[5G Handover]] procedure，在不同 carrier frequency / cell 之間切換，使 jammer 必須持續偵聽並重新調整攻擊頻率。

來源明確把這個方法連到論文〈Enhancing 5G Resilience to Smart-Jammer Attacks: Incorporating Frequency Hopping to 5G〉，並說該論文提交給 Spring 2025 IEEE VTC conference，由 [[Aalborg University]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz Technology Center Denmark]] 合作完成。

主要測試設備與條件：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator；來源說 at the time of writing 可達 Release 18 features。
- 測試 CMX500 配置有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，提供四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 使用 control PC 控制 CMX500、measurement PC 控制 [[UE]]；M.2 modem 可直接以 RF cables 連到 CMX500，phone 類 DUT 則使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 使用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79；center frequencies 分別為 2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- 基本 HO repetition interval 為 5 s，除非另有指定；UE received power 固定為 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping frequency 100 Hz，即每 10 ms 一個 ICMP message；iPerf data rate 每秒更新一次；target uplink / downlink data rate 均為 2 Mbit/s，因來源稱這是 good quality video streams 的 minimum requirement。

主要量測結果：

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源沒有提供 modem A / modem B 的品牌、型號、chipset、firmware、antenna configuration 或 commercial name。
- 來源沒有提供實際 smart jammer hardware、jammer waveform、jammer power、距離、偵測延遲、追蹤演算法或攻擊成功率；多數測試是在 frequency hopping / handover feasibility 與 QoS impact，而非實體 jammer 對抗實驗。
- 來源提到 3GPP TS 38.300，但未標示 release / version。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 23.501]] V15.4.0（2018-12）作為 5QI QoS table，但白皮書本身是 August 2025；是否需用較新 3GPP release 做 mission-critical QoS 對照仍未裁決。
- 來源說 CMX500 at the time of writing can reach up to Release 18 features，但未提供具體 CMX500 software version、option list、hardware order numbers 或 full configuration。
- 來源未量化 security improvement，例如 jammer reacquisition time、probability of detection、probability of interruption 或 hop pattern entropy。
- Future work 包含 MOS、more random operating frequency configuration、dual connectivity / multi-connectivity 與 DAPS handovers，但本來源未實作。

NR-NTN 技術演進 › Release 17：NTN baseline
[[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 明確稱 [[3GPP Release 17]] 是 NTN 的 technology baseline。

Release 17 正式將 NTN 導入 5G system specifications：

- [[IoT-NTN]]：以 [[NB-IoT]] / eMTC 為基礎的 NTN enhancement。
- [[NR-NTN]]：5G NR 對 satellite access 的 enhancement。
- FR1 S-band / L-band 中的 n255、n256 初始 bands，採 [[FDD]]。
- UE 需要 [[GNSS]] positioning 能力，以便計算 timing advance 與 Doppler precompensation。
- [[SIB19]] 導入 NTN system information，提供 satellite ephemeris、timing、reference location、validity timer 等資訊。
- PHY / MAC / RRC / NAS 各層均有 NTN adaptations，包括 time delay、Doppler shift compensation、path loss、timing advance、random access、HARQ、timer operation 與 mobility。
- MAC / HARQ 可擴充到 32 HARQ processes，並允許 disable HARQ feedback。
- RRC 層導入 NTN conditional handover。
- 架構上優先採 [[transparent payload]]，即 satellite 以 bent pipe 方式轉送，gNB 位於地面。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming
[[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是 mission-critical / tactical 5G 測試問題：在 contested RF / [[EW]] 環境中，如何讓 deployed private [[5G]] connections 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具服務連續性。

citation.wiki_page: wiki/concepts/5G private network resilience against smart jamming.md

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。

- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Fading profiles and test channels
來源整理 [[TR 38.811]]、[[TR 38.901]] 與 [[TS 38.181]] 的 NTN channel model / test condition：

- [[CDL]]：clustered delay line，適用於 S-band / Ka-band，含 elevation / azimuth 的 3D model。
- [[TDL]]：tapped delay line，用於 multipath power-delay profile。
- TR 38.811 定義 NTN-CDL 與 NTN-TDL profiles，各有 LOS / NLOS profiles。
- TS 38.181 為 SAN testing 定義 NTN-TDLA100、NTN-TDLC5、moving propagation condition。
- Rel. 19 導入 NGSO time-varying Doppler shift and propagation delay channel model，用於更 realistic demodulation / RRM tests。

answer.text:
### Short answer
The supported chain is Aerospace / Defense private-5G resilience in contested RF / EW environments → measure handover interruption, RTT, packet loss / jitter, throughput, and application QoS → use a signaling tester that can emulate 5G NR cells, execute mobility / handover scenarios, and run IP application measurements; the cited source uses R&S CMX500 as the 5G network emulator for this setup [61][62][64][31].
### Chain mapping
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tactical edge connectivity, smart jamming / improved EW tactics, contested spectrum, autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency, secure command-and-control networks, and tactical private 5G adoption are listed as mission / market drivers [65]. | Handover interruption interval is a key metric, with modem B never exceeding 75 ms and modem A reaching 150 ms in some cases [64]. | The tester needs 5G NR signaling / network emulation and mobility / handover execution, because the tested mitigation maps resilience to 5G handover signaling and uses CMX500 as the network emulator [62][31]. | Market driver [65]; metric [64]; tester role [31][62]. |
| Mission-critical / tactical 5G requires service continuity against smart jamming in contested RF / EW environments [61]. | RTT is measured, with more than 90% of RTT below 20 ms and worst 0.1 percentile near 80 ms for modem B and 200 ms for modem A [64]. | The tester needs IP application measurement capability such as Ping and throughput, because CMX500 application testing includes Ping, iPerf, throughput, and IP logging [5]. | Requirement [61]; metric [64]; capability [5]. |
| Public safety, critical infrastructure, and military purposes need reliable, fast, secure communications, and real-time video stream needs at least 2 Mbit/s [3]. | The white-paper setup used uplink / downlink target data rate of 2 Mbit/s, ping at 100 Hz, and iPerf updates every second [2]. | The tester needs application-layer test functions for IP throughput and video / audio, because UAV signaling test solution lists IP throughput, Video, and Audio as application-layer tests [40]. | Requirement [3]; measurable setup [2]; capability [40]. |
| The resilience problem is mapped to handover frequency hopping across cells / carrier frequencies so that the jammer must listen and readjust to every change [62]. | The setup uses three 5G SA cells on n41, n78, and n79 with center frequencies 2.50713 GHz, 3.30087 GHz, and 4.62399 GHz [34]. | The tester needs multi-cell 5G SA signaling with NR FR1 RF resources, because the CMX500 test setup had two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports, and up to eight cells [31]. | Requirement / method [62]; measurable carriers [34]; capability [31]. |
| The constraint is to harden the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT by putting the strategy in the network / infrastructure / orchestration around it [3]. | The test measures QoS impact under handover-based frequency hopping rather than modifying the DUT [35]. | The tester needs to act as a network-side emulator around the DUT, and CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing [6]. | Constraint [3]; measurement scope [35]; capability [6]. |
| UAV products can use Radio, Wi‑Fi, LTE, 5G, SATCOM, RTK, and proprietary radio technologies [39]. | Supported signaling-test RF measurements include Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [40]. | The tester needs LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test coverage, because the UAV signaling test solution says CMX500 provides LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test over 400 MHz to 8 GHz [40]. | Requirement context [39]; measurable parameters [40]; capability [40]. |
| CMX500 Callbox is positioned for RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D validation [9]. | Example non-signaling / RF validation use cases include sensitivity testing, desense testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX switching, and non-signaling verification [72]. | The tester needs both signaling and non-signaling validation workflows, because CMX500 Callbox explicitly lists Non-Sig Testing and R&D Testing among its testing phases [71]. | Use-case scope [9]; measurable RF/non-signaling areas [72]; capability category [71]. |
### Minimum capability set supported by the passages
| Tester capability | Why it is required in the chain | Supported product / option facts | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5G NR signaling and network emulation | Handover frequency hopping requires 5G handover signaling across multiple cells / carriers [62]. | R&S CMX500 supports NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, and it is a one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [6]. | [62][6] |
| Multi-cell FR1 setup | The resilience test used three 5G SA cells on n41, n78, and n79 [34]. | The tested CMX500 configuration had two NR FR1-capable RF units, four RF ports, and could create up to eight cells [31]. | [34][31] |
| Mobility / handover testing | The mitigation is implemented as handover frequency hopping between carrier frequencies / cells [29]. | CMX500 Callbox lists Mobility Testing as an application / mobility use case [74]. | [29][74] |
| IP application measurements | The measurable outcomes include RTT, throughput, WebRTC statistics, jitter buffer delay, and lost or discarded packets [64]. | CMX500 KA100 includes iPerf, Ping, throughput, IP logging, FTP, HTTP, DNS, and related IP services [5]. | [64][5] |
| Throughput / video QoS testing | The mission need includes real-time video stream of at least 2 Mbit/s [3]. | The UAV signaling test solution lists Application layer test items including IP throughput, Video, and Audio [40]. | [3][40] |
| RF / non-signaling verification | UAV communication validation can require RF parameters such as Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [40]. | CMX500 Callbox lists Non-Sig Testing as a testing phase and non-signaling verification as an example use case [71][72]. | [40][71][72] |
| WLAN / cellular desense and multi-technology validation | UAV products may combine Wi‑Fi, LTE, 5G, proprietary radio, SATCOM, RTK, and other communications [39]. | CMX500 Callbox includes WLAN / cellular desense validation in its use-case positioning, and CMX500 supports WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements [9][6]. | [39][9][6] |
### Limitations
The passages do not provide a formal Aerospace / Defense procurement requirement that directly mandates a specific CMX500 option stack [32][69].
The smart-jamming source does not provide physical jammer hardware, jammer waveform, jammer power, tracking algorithm, detection delay, or attack success rate [32].
The handover-frequency-hopping result mainly demonstrates feasibility, latency, and QoS impact, not a physical smart-jammer confrontation test [35].
The UAV signaling test solution does not provide test cases, standard versions, channel bandwidth, MIMO layers, OTA / conducted setup, pass / fail limits, or measurement uncertainty [40].
The CMX500 Callbox source lists non-signaling verification and other use cases but does not define pass / fail standards for the testing phases [71].

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；
- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；
- can the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT be hardened against [[Smart Jamming]] by using legacy FH capabilities。

來源特別強調 constraint：不修改 [[DUT]]；策略應放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration around it。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）補充：public safety agencies、critical infrastructure industries 與 military purposes 依賴 reliable、fast、secure communications；TETRA 等傳統系統 maximum data bit rate below 30 kbit/s，無法滿足 real-time video stream 至少 2 Mbit/s 與 extended reality 至少 30 Mbit/s 的需求。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

Smart Jamming › Mitigation direction
兩份來源的主要 mitigation direction 都是 [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]。白皮書將其具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：

- 使用 [[5G Handover]] 在 n41、n78、n79 等不同 carrier frequency / cell 間切換；
- 讓 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change；
- 若 procedure completed at a high frequency rate，jammer would not be able to keep up；
- dynamic target-cell activation 可隱藏 next hop information。

使用限制：白皮書沒有實體 jammer 對抗實驗細節，主要量測 handover interruption、RTT、iPerf 與 [[WebRTC]] QoS。

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] white paper《5G hardening against smart jammer attacks》，文件標示 **PD 3610.1591.52 | Version 01.00 | August 2025 (ch)**，作者為 [[Miguel Villanueva Fernandez]] 與 [[Kristian Hausgaard Soerensen]]。raw frontmatter 顯示原始 PDF 於 2026-09-17 轉檔；本文內容日期以文件頁尾的 August 2025 為準。

白皮書主張：mission-critical、critical infrastructure 與 military 5G use cases 需要比商用網路更高的可靠性；但較便宜且可取得的 [[SDR]] equipment 可能被改造成 [[Smart Jamming]] 裝置，追蹤目前使用的通訊頻率並在特定時刻發射 noise 以干擾連線。來源提出以 [[Handover frequency hopping]] 作為 5G overlay countermeasure：利用所有 3GPP-compliant commercial 5G devices 都支援的 legacy [[5G Handover]] procedure，在不同 carrier frequency / cell 之間切換，使 jammer 必須持續偵聽並重新調整攻擊頻率。

來源明確把這個方法連到論文〈Enhancing 5G Resilience to Smart-Jammer Attacks: Incorporating Frequency Hopping to 5G〉，並說該論文提交給 Spring 2025 IEEE VTC conference，由 [[Aalborg University]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz Technology Center Denmark]] 合作完成。

主要測試設備與條件：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator；來源說 at the time of writing 可達 Release 18 features。
- 測試 CMX500 配置有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，提供四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 使用 control PC 控制 CMX500、measurement PC 控制 [[UE]]；M.2 modem 可直接以 RF cables 連到 CMX500，phone 類 DUT 則使用 [[R&S CMU-Z10]] small anechoic chamber 與 [[Mini-Circuits ZN2PD2-63-S+]] RF combiner。
- 使用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79；center frequencies 分別為 2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- 基本 HO repetition interval 為 5 s，除非另有指定；UE received power 固定為 -70.2 dBm；DL/UL pattern 7:2；DL MCS 10、UL MCS 4；SISO。
- ping frequency 100 Hz，即每 10 ms 一個 ICMP message；iPerf data rate 每秒更新一次；target uplink / downlink data rate 均為 2 Mbit/s，因來源稱這是 good quality video streams 的 minimum requirement。

主要量測結果：

5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源沒有提供 modem A / modem B 的品牌、型號、chipset、firmware、antenna configuration 或 commercial name。
- 來源沒有提供實際 smart jammer hardware、jammer waveform、jammer power、距離、偵測延遲、追蹤演算法或攻擊成功率；多數測試是在 frequency hopping / handover feasibility 與 QoS impact，而非實體 jammer 對抗實驗。
- 來源提到 3GPP TS 38.300，但未標示 release / version。
- 來源引用 [[3GPP TS 23.501]] V15.4.0（2018-12）作為 5QI QoS table，但白皮書本身是 August 2025；是否需用較新 3GPP release 做 mission-critical QoS 對照仍未裁決。
- 來源說 CMX500 at the time of writing can reach up to Release 18 features，但未提供具體 CMX500 software version、option list、hardware order numbers 或 full configuration。
- 來源未量化 security improvement，例如 jammer reacquisition time、probability of detection、probability of interruption 或 hop pattern entropy。
- Future work 包含 MOS、more random operating frequency configuration、dual connectivity / multi-connectivity 與 DAPS handovers，但本來源未實作。

Handover frequency hopping › 測試配置摘要
依 [[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]：

- 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 5G network emulator。
- 測試 CMX500 有兩個 [[NR FR1]] capable RF units，四個 RF ports，可建立最多八個 cells。
- 測試用三個 [[5G SA]] cells：n41、n78、n79。
- Cell center frequencies：2.50713 GHz、3.30087 GHz、4.62399 GHz。
- Default HO command interval：5 s。
- UE received power：-70.2 dBm。
- DL/UL pattern：7:2。
- MCS：downlink 10、uplink 4。
- Antenna / stream：SISO。
- ping frequency：100 Hz，即 10 ms 一個 ICMP message。
- iPerf update：每秒一次。
- target data rate：uplink / downlink 均為 2 Mbit/s。

Handover frequency hopping › 使用限制
- 本方法不代表 5G 已內建完整 anti-jam [[FHSS]] waveform；來源明確說 5G 的 key missing component 是 frequency hopping，而本方法是利用 handover feature 實作 overlay hopping。
- 來源沒有實體 jammer 測試細節；結果主要證明 handover-based hopping 的 feasibility、latency 與 QoS impact。
- 來源沒有 modem A / B 型號，因此不可推論特定商用 UE 的可靠性。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 在此是 test setup 中的 network emulator；本 Market source 不是產品規格書，頁尾也說 data without tolerance limits is not binding。
- 引用 QoS 結果時必須保留 test conditions：n41 / n78 / n79、SISO、-70.2 dBm、MCS 10 / 4、2 Mbit/s target、one-hour Teams call。

Signaling test solution › UAV 與通訊技術
- [[UAV 通訊]] — 本來源補充 UAV 產品使用 Radio、Wi‑Fi、LTE、5G、SATCOM、RTK 與 proprietary radio 的例子。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming
[[5G private network resilience against smart jamming]] 是 mission-critical / tactical 5G 測試問題：在 contested RF / [[EW]] 環境中，如何讓 deployed private [[5G]] connections 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具服務連續性。

cited_passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 技術映射
來源將 resilience 問題映射到兩類 5G / FH 行為：

1. Mapping to [[5G Handover]] signaling。
2. Mapping to 5G frequency-hopping signaling / legacy [[FHSS]] capabilities。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 將此具體化為 [[Handover frequency hopping]]：使用 [[5G Handover]] 在多個 cells / carrier frequencies 之間切換，使 jammer 必須 constantly listen and readjust to every change。來源說 prerequisite 是 highly reliable inter-frequency handovers，以便在 constantly changing carrier frequency 時仍維持 dependable communications link。

citation.wiki_page: wiki/concepts/5G private network resilience against smart jamming.md

cited_passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。
